tickets.title: Set up the repo layout
tickets.description: engine, libworldforge, forge-cli, data, viewer, game, tools. data/ shared between generator and game as single source of truth.

tickets.title: E1: engine scaffold with headless test target and CI
tickets.description: engine/ with CMake and a vcpkg manifest. SDL3 window, Vulkan triangle via vk-bootstrap and VMA, Dear ImGui, Tracy, Catch2. Null backends for window, renderer, audio and input; the headless build is the default test target. CI runs unit and headless tests on every push with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on one job. Done when CI is green and the headless test boots and ticks an empty scene. Doc 17.

tickets.title: E2: render a scene with a golden image test
tickets.description: Asset cooker (cgltf, stb_image, meshoptimizer, KTX2), cooked binary formats, PBR materials, cascaded shadow maps, camera-relative transforms, debug draw. HLSL via DXC to SPIR-V. Done when the golden image test of a reference scene passes offscreen in CI. Doc 17.

tickets.title: E3: world model with save/load and replay tests
tickets.description: EnTT scene, reflection, binary serialisation, scene files, hot reload for data and shaders, the command layer, one seeded RNG per system, recorded input stream. Done when save/load round-trip and replay-hash tests pass. Doc 17, doc 14, doc 15.

tickets.title: E4: bodies, animation and audio; Stage 0 runs here
tickets.description: Jolt integration, character controller, fixed timestep with render interpolation, ozz skeletal animation, montages with frame-accurate wind-up and recovery, root motion, miniaudio playback. Done when the doc 18 grey-box arena is rebuilt on the engine and the Stage 0 gate can be run. Doc 17, doc 18.

tickets.title: E5: terrain and streaming with a headless streaming test
tickets.description: Heightmap clipmaps from the forged heightmap.r16, splat materials, cell streaming on a background thread with a budget, mesh LODs and impostors, Recast navmesh per cell stitched at borders. Done when a scripted player crosses every cell boundary of a forged 4 km world headless with no leaks. Doc 17, doc 08.

tickets.title: E6: content layer; the 500 m slice is playable
tickets.description: Lua host via sol2, bindings, the RPG data layer cooked from data/, RmlUi screens, the ledger as the save file. Done when the doc 18 slice map is playable end to end. Doc 17, doc 18.

tickets.title: E7: atmosphere and the editor
tickets.description: Time of day, sky, height and volumetric fog, weather, vegetation instancing with wind, forge-time reverb stamps, then the ImGui editor. Done when the doc 16 unification stack is implemented. Doc 17, doc 16, doc 12.

tickets.title: forge-cli wrapper
tickets.description: PNGs, manifest output, batch runs. The iteration surface for all world design.

tickets.title: Local web map viewer
tickets.description: Node 22 plus canvas. Toggleable overlays for elevation, biomes, rivers, roads, territory, POIs, contested cells. The tool you'll use most.

tickets.title: Batch seed harness
tickets.description: Run 1,000 seeds through phases 0-11 and report validation-gate failures by cause. Catches over-constrained axioms before players do.

tickets.title: JSON to cooked data tool
tickets.description: Author in JSON (diffable, generator-readable), cook to the engine's binary data format at build time so the runtime never parses JSON.

tickets.title: Data cross-reference validator
tickets.description: Does every axiom's biome injection reference a real biome? Does every synergy reference real axioms?

tickets.title: CI: determinism, golden images, save round-trip
tickets.description: The three tests that matter. Determinism runs on every commit.

tickets.title: Content folder convention enforcement
tickets.description: Organise by feature, not asset type. Type-based folders stop scaling around the thousandth asset.

tickets.title: Evaluate Perforce migration trigger
tickets.description: Switch when LFS operations cost minutes rather than seconds, typically a few tens of GB of content. Do not adopt pre-emptively.

tickets.title: Compile time budget review
tickets.description: Module boundaries, forward declarations, header bloat, unity builds. The daily tax matters more than almost any technical decision over years.

tickets.title: Dependency policy check
tickets.description: The vcpkg manifest is the written-down list. tools/check_deps.py fails CI when the manifest and the doc 17 stack table disagree.
